## Example 4.9 {#iv4-example-4-9 .vector-lesson .magnitude-lesson }

<p>Given <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}=\underset{\sim}{i}+2\underset{\sim}{j}+3\underset{\sim}{k}"></span>.
